audit.source_text:
import BusyBeaver.ZFC.Lukasiewicz
open SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC
#check Lukasiewicz.k
#check Lukasiewicz.s
#check Lukasiewicz.peirce
#check Tarski.ex_falso
#check Tarski.classical
#check Tarski.complete
#print axioms Lukasiewicz.k
#print axioms Lukasiewicz.s
#print axioms Lukasiewicz.peirce
#print axioms Lukasiewicz.composition
#print axioms Tarski.ex_falso
#print axioms Tarski.classical
#print axioms Tarski.complete

-- A caller supplies neither an extra classical basis nor an empty-theory basis.
example {Ax : Tarski.NF → Prop} (f : Tarski.NF)
    (hval : ∀ (D : Type) (mem : D → D → Prop),
      (∀ a, Ax a → ∀ e : Nat → D, Tarski.Sat mem e a) →
        ∀ e : Nat → D, Tarski.Sat mem e f) : Tarski.Thm Ax f :=
  Tarski.complete f hval
audit.output:
SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.Lukasiewicz.k.{u} {α : Type u} {imp : α → α → α} {T : α → Prop}
  (h : Lukasiewicz.Implicational imp T) (a b : α) : T (imp a (imp b a))
SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.Lukasiewicz.s.{u} {α : Type u} {imp : α → α → α} {T : α → Prop}
  (h : Lukasiewicz.Implicational imp T) (a b c : α) : T (imp (imp a (imp b c)) (imp (imp a b) (imp a c)))
SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.Lukasiewicz.peirce.{u} {α : Type u} {imp : α → α → α} {T : α → Prop}
  (h : Lukasiewicz.Implicational imp T) (a b : α) : T (imp (imp (imp a b) a) a)
SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.Tarski.ex_falso {Ax : Tarski.NF → Prop} (a : Tarski.NF) : Tarski.Thm Ax (Tarski.NF.bot.imp a)
SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.Tarski.classical (Ax : Tarski.NF → Prop) :
  Kalmar.Classical Tarski.NF.imp Tarski.NF.bot (Tarski.Thm Ax)
SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.Tarski.complete {Ax : Tarski.NF → Prop} (f : Tarski.NF)
  (hval :
    ∀ (D : Type) (mem : D → D → Prop),
      (∀ (a : Tarski.NF), Ax a → ∀ (e : Nat → D), Tarski.Sat mem e a) → ∀ (e : Nat → D), Tarski.Sat mem e f) :
  Tarski.Thm Ax f
'SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.Lukasiewicz.k' does not depend on any axioms
'SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.Lukasiewicz.s' does not depend on any axioms
'SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.Lukasiewicz.peirce' does not depend on any axioms
'SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.Lukasiewicz.composition' does not depend on any axioms
'SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.Tarski.ex_falso' does not depend on any axioms
'SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.Tarski.classical' does not depend on any axioms
'SetTheory.BusyBeaver.ZFC.Tarski.complete' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
